title: Are You Sleeping? with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to Are You Sleeping? with Lulu the little duck! It is morning in the garden, the golden bells go ding, dang, dong, and Lulu gently wakes up Pip the kitten, Bunny and Frog.

A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 18th century; English words 19th century) for children aged 2 to 6.
